name: freemarker-js
description: Browser-targeted dependency-free port of the FreeMarker template engine

scripts.typecheck: npx -y -p typescript@5 tsc --noEmit --allowJs --checkJs --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler $(git ls-files 'src/**/*.js') 2>&1 | grep 'error TS' | grep -vE 'error TS(2322|2488|2339|2345|2739|2740|2416)' | grep .; test $? -eq 1
